description.value: Sungiven Foods is a community-rooted Asian supermarket chain with locations across Metro Vancouver, positioning itself as a 'healthy daily meals provider' focused on natural, less-processed foods. The Surrey location stocks a wide range of Asian and international groceries including fresh produce, meat, seafood, dairy, and packaged goods alongside an in-store Sungiven Kitchen offering prepared dishes. With private-label brands certified to international food safety standards and a strong local-and-organic ethos, it stands out from mainstream supermarkets.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sungivenfoods.ca is live and clearly describes an active Asian supermarket chain with a Surrey location confirmed by OSM tags. The site lists a broad product range (produce, meat, seafood, dairy, packaged goods, beverages, snacks) and a 'Sungiven Kitchen' section with prepared dishes, confirming basic groceries and ready-to-eat/hot food. No website or OSM evidence addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM record.

OSM address lacks postal code and unit number (unit 108); full address from OSM is '3211 152 Street, Surrey' — website lists Surrey as a store city but does not display the specific street address in the fetched content, so address match is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible supermarket with a confirmed Surrey location and a live website. Useful resupply stop for touring cyclists.
